hero.description: We design your AI solutions, your automations and your custom tools. A technical team that evolves with the latest tools, for results that actually run.
hero.summary: MAWT is an AI agency in Geneva. We help SMEs and growing companies across French speaking Switzerland integrate artificial intelligence, automate their processes and ship custom tools. From strategy to deployment, we build solutions that run, not slides.

paragraphs: MAWT is an AI agency based in Geneva. We help SMEs and growing companies across French speaking Switzerland put artificial intelligence to work: automating what repeats, speeding up what matters, shipping tools built for their business.

Before being an AI agency, we are a technical team. We have written code for years and we evolve with the latest tools and practices, without chasing the hype. That is what separates a demo from a system that holds up in production.
Our promise fits in one line: solutions that run, not recommendations. From the first conversation to deployment, you talk to the people who build.

problem.headline_2: Inside your company, it is still a promise.
